description:
Create a project. The description (the video concept/topic) seeds script
    generation, so write a meaningful one. Pass video_format='portrait' for a
    vertical video — every shot, overlay, and the export are then composed for
    a 9:16 frame. The response's web_url is the project's page in the web app —
    share it so the user can follow along.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel to create the project in, from list_channels or create_channel
channel_id.title: Channel Id

description.description: The video concept/topic; seeds script generation, so make it specific and meaningful
description.title: Description

title.description: Project title shown in the app
title.title: Title

video_format.description: Output frame shape: 'landscape' (16:9, the default — YouTube and long-form) or 'portrait' (9:16 — Shorts, Reels, TikTok). Fixed once the storyboard is generated, so pick it up front.
video_format.title: Video Format

name: create_project
title: Create project
